description: A forward operating base commander must publish the next day's controlled-access plan for four routine support visits, assigning each visit an entry gate and time and recording the access control required by each section.

shared_context.S1: Four routine support visits are scheduled for tomorrow: a vehicle-inspection team, a water-system contractor, a network-maintenance team, and a refrigerated repair-parts delivery.
shared_context.S2: The available controlled entry points are Gate 1, Gate 2, Gate 3, and Service Gate 4.
shared_context.S3: The standard receiving windows are 0600, 0800, 1000, and 1300, with one visit normally assigned to each window.
shared_context.S4: Col. Whitfield must sign the access plan before it is posted to the guard desk and the receiving yard.
shared_context.S5: At the routine morning access-plan review, the commander checks each scheduled visit with security, facilities, signal, and logistics before signing the plan.

PF1.text: The vehicle-inspection team's current access authorization is valid only through Gate 2 at 1000, and a security escort must be assigned; Maj. Torres confirmed the authorization with the guard-desk supervisor this morning, but the updated pass record has not yet been posted.

PF2.text: The water-system contractor is bringing a 3.8-meter-wide service unit that cannot clear the other entry points, so the visit must use Service Gate 4 at 0800 and have a facilities spotter; CWO Patel measured the unit against the gate plans today, but the receiving-yard notice has not yet been updated.

PF3.text: The network-maintenance team's equipment requires the shielded access route through Gate 1 at 1300, and a signal escort must meet the team there; Lt. Brooks received the equipment compatibility confirmation from the network section this morning, but it is not yet on the access brief.

PF4.text: The refrigerated repair-parts delivery must use Gate 3 at 0600 so it can reach the powered receiving dock before the cold-chain handoff, and a dock-power verification must be recorded; SFC Han confirmed the carrier's delivery instruction today, but the appointment change has not yet been entered in the yard schedule.

acceptance_conditions: The vehicle-inspection team must be assigned Gate 2 at 1000 with a security escort.
The water-system contractor must be assigned Service Gate 4 at 0800 with a facilities spotter.
The network-maintenance team must be assigned Gate 1 at 1300 with a signal escort.
The refrigerated repair-parts delivery must be assigned Gate 3 at 0600 with dock-power verification.
The access plan must include all four required control actions.
The water-system gate constraint must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'security_escort' and c['target'] == 'vehicle_inspection_team' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'facilities_spotter' and c['target'] == 'water_system_contractor' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'signal_escort' and c['target'] == 'network_maintenance_team' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'dock_power_verification' and c['target'] == 'refrigerated_parts_delivery' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The authorization restricts the vehicle-inspection team to Gate 2 at exactly 1000 and adds the required security-escort commitment.
The 3.8-meter service unit restricts the water contractor to Service Gate 4 at exactly 0800, adds a facilities spotter, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The shielded-route requirement fixes the network team's entry at Gate 1 at exactly 1300 and requires a signal escort.
The cold-chain delivery instruction fixes the repair-parts entry at Gate 3 at exactly 0600 and requires dock-power verification.
